failure_type: wind / gusts + late detection (short sensing range) + UAV too fast to react
explanation: The UAV collided with a moving obstacle at 9.6 seconds due to a combination of environmental and operational factors. The 5.5 m/s headwind, limited 11.7 m sensing range, and high cruise speed of 6.0 m/s prevented the planner from maintaining clearance, as confirmed by counterfactuals showing that mitigating any of these factors would have prevented the failure.
